svg.text: I code with LLM agents most days. Claude Code writes a good part of the
code, and Cline running local models like Qwen2.5-Coder through Ollama
handles the repetitive edits. I bring the problem, the domain knowledge
and the decisions, write the spec and the constraints, then read the
diff and run the tests before anything gets committed, and change course
when the result does not match what the data says. I still get things
wrong this way. I would rather tell you how the code got written than
have you assume, and if something in these repos is broken, it is on me
